messages:
rachel: Quick sync 1: Launch gate checklist for multi-tier inference. Need rapid sign-off from Docs, SRE, Pricing, and Support.

ben: high-level buckets?

rachel: Safety/regression, SLOs & fallback, observability & alerts, customer docs/runbooks, billing/quota rules. One owner per bucket.

olga: I can own docs/runbooks. Items: narrow quickstart, migration notes for Dedicated, rollback steps, customer-facing retry guidance.

nate: Pricing: define free-tier caps, committed vs burst pricing, preview credits, and explicit wording for KV-cache billing.

ben: SLOs: propose p95 <= 300ms standard, <= 650ms long context. Error rate < 0.4%. Degradation rule: sustained 2x p95 for 10m -> automatic model downgrade.

deploy-bot: Note: automated downgrade needs circuit-breaker and verified rollback path (owner: eng-runtime).

rachel: Observability needs per-model token cost, trace->request-id linkage, and cost-burn dashboard. Alerts: SLO burn >50% in 5m or error spike >0.5% in 1m.

olga: I'll add a single-page "Launch Card" summarizing SLA, workload profiles, and suggested quantization knobs per tier.

nate: Ops asks free-tier QPS limit of 8 qps/account with clear throttle message + billing link. For Dedicated trials include overage clause.

ben: Support: Tier 1 playbook ready + 72-hour post-launch eng-sre rota. Owners: eng-platform + eng-sre.

rachel: Gating to GA: 1) all checklist items green, 2) regression smoke pass, 3) load test at 2x expected traffic for 30m within p95 targets, 4) pricing page live, 5) 72-hour rota staffed.

olga: I'll publish quickstart + rollback steps by EOD and attach to checklist doc.

nate: I'll update pricing + quota table and loop in finance by 2pm.
achel: Any absolute blockers?

ben: Must have automated fallback + rollback tested. No manual-only emergency paths.

olga: Docs: must include escalation matrix.

nate: Pricing: explicit Dedicated trial overage policy.

rachel: I'll draft a one-page Launch Gate and assign owners, then reconvene tomorrow 09:30 for go/no-go. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy window 2025-05-12 01:00 UTC
